description: Share one receiving school's report card: the snapshot is stored exactly as given, and a share_id is returned that opens it until expires_at (a UTC timestamp in the future) or until it is revoked. No viewer is recorded. Answered only to main KSAserver's own key; any other caller is refused.

expires_at.description: When the share ends: a UTC timestamp in the future

snapshot.description: The report card as shared; stored exactly as given

name: report_card_share
title: Report Card Share
